name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: A text field that opens a listbox of matches.
use: One value from a list too long to scan, found by typing.

instead.when: The list is short enough to read without typing
The list runs commands instead of filling a field

keyboard.action: Open the list and move the active option, wrapping at the ends
Move to the first or the last option while the list is open
Choose the active option and close the list
Close the list; the field keeps its text
Filter the options and open the list on the first match

platform.fallback: The list sits in the flow directly under the field, at its own width

classes.name: combobox
classes.description: The wrapper that anchors the listbox to the field

classes.name: combobox-toggle
classes.description: A chevron button at the field's end that opens and closes the list

states.name: open
states.description: On the field with role="combobox": the chevron turns over

example:
Tokyo
Singapore
No regions match.
